statusLifecycleNote: superseded is a lifecycle state appended by a successor revision; it is admitted for every classification.

wording.describe: Compliance, certification or attestation wording is admitted only for an external fact backed by a retained attestation receipt.
Universal, counted or inventory coverage wording needs a fresh reader observation of the same measure.
Formal-verification wording is admitted only for an external fact backed by a proof-discharge receipt.
Availability wording is admitted only for a current product claim backed by a fresh release receipt.
Absolute or guarantee wording is admitted only for a quoted external fact or when the limits note explicitly softens it.
Standard lifecycle assertions need an external-url ref with a declared lifecycle and a present effectiveAt.
Proposed architecture or proposed status needs a visible Lab or Preview label; page posture is enforced by the publisher.

CLAIM_NOT_DECLARED.meaning: A referenced claim revision is not declared.

CLAIM_DIGEST_MISMATCH.meaning: A pinned claim digest does not match the declared document digest.

CLAIM_CONTRACT_UNSUPPORTED.meaning: The document contract is not ui-claim.v1 at a known version.

CLAIM_CLASSIFICATION_INVALID.meaning: Classification is outside the closed vocabulary.

CLAIM_STATUS_INVALID.meaning: Status is outside the closed vocabulary or not admitted for the classification.

CLAIM_BASIS_MISSING.meaning: Basis is absent, under 40 characters, boilerplate, identical to the statement, or a copy variant lacks its own basis.

CLAIM_SOURCE_REQUIRED.meaning: sourceRefs are missing, lack a required digest or locator, or the classification's required evidence kind is absent.

CLAIM_SOURCE_KIND_UNSUPPORTED.meaning: A sourceRef kind is outside the closed vocabulary.

CLAIM_DATE_MISSING.meaning: observedAt, effectiveAt or a required ref observedAt is absent or malformed.

CLAIM_EFFECTIVE_FUTURE_STATUS.meaning: effectiveAt is in the future for a status other than proposed.

CLAIM_RULES_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED.meaning: The document names a rules version the rules file does not know.

CLAIM_COMPLIANCE_UNSUPPORTED.meaning: Compliance or attestation wording without an external fact backed by an attestation receipt.

CLAIM_COVERAGE_UNSOURCED.meaning: Coverage or universal wording without a fresh reader observation of the same measure.

CLAIM_COVERAGE_STALE.meaning: Coverage wording whose required reading observation is older than its freshness window.

CLAIM_OBSERVATION_STALE.meaning: A digest-backed observation ref is older than its freshness window.

CLAIM_VERIFICATION_UNSUPPORTED.meaning: Formal-verification wording without a proof-discharge receipt.

CLAIM_AVAILABILITY_UNSUPPORTED.meaning: Availability wording without a current product claim backed by a fresh release receipt.

CLAIM_ABSOLUTE_UNSUPPORTED.meaning: Absolute or guarantee wording without a quoted external fact or a limits note that softens it.

CLAIM_STANDARD_STATE_UNSOURCED.meaning: Standard lifecycle wording without an external-url ref declaring its lifecycle and a present effectiveAt.

CLAIM_LAB_LABEL_MISSING.meaning: Proposed architecture or proposed status without a Lab or Preview label.

CLAIM_PROPOSED_POSTURE_MISMATCH.meaning: A proposed claim on a page without research posture; not wired in this tool half.

CLAIM_TEXT_MISMATCH.meaning: Claim-bound copy does not equal the approved statement or a basis-bearing copy variant.

CLAIM_REQUIRED.meaning: Copy triggers a wording rule with no claim attachment.

CLAIM_SUPERSEDED_REFERENCED.meaning: A current section references a superseded revision without historical context; not wired in this tool half.

CLAIM_HISTORICAL_WITHOUT_WINDOW.meaning: Historical status without effectiveAt and supersededAt.

CLAIM_HISTORICAL_RENDERED_CURRENT.meaning: Historical claim rendered as current; not wired in this tool half.
